stage0015_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$オットー$$
「So, they sent in a scout first...」

stage0015_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$オットー$$
「What is with that speed!?」

stage0015_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$レイアム$$
「I can't believe it...!
　At triple a normal unit's speed through the debris...」

stage0015_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「Captain, pull the ship back!
　We have to run!」

stage0015_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$オットー$$
「$$アルベルト$$!
　I am the captain of this ship!」

stage0015_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「This is no time for that!
　That's a $$シナンジュ$$! No ordinary machine!」

stage0015_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「Our company's experimental unit,
　en route from Granada to the Von Braun test site,
　was hijacked by Neo Zeon!」

stage0015_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「That's the prototype for that $$シナンジュ$$!
　No average mobile suit could beat it in a fight!」

stage0015_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
Neo Zeon Soldier
「Captain $$アンジェロ$$,
　at this rate we won't catch up to the colonel!」

stage0015_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「It's fine.
　We mustn't get in the colonel's way.」

stage0015_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Our job as the honor guard
　is to clean up the trash fleeing the colonel.」

stage0015_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「At this rate, we'll lose our chance to flee!
　Fall back, now!」

stage0015_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$オットー$$
「Be quiet, $$アルベルト$$!
　At this point, we have no choice but to fight!」

stage0015_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$オットー$$
「Launch all units!
　Don't forget we have the deputy chief of staff
　and the civilians we rescued aboard!」

stage0015_04:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「I said fall back!
　You stubborn fool!」

stage0015_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$オットー$$
「I don't want to hear that from you!」

stage0015_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$エマ$$
「The ensign's being held in reserve
　on the ship, just in case.」

stage0015_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$エマ$$
（As $$アデナウアー・パラヤ$$, he's probably
　trying to win favor with the Marcenas family...）

stage0015_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$シン$$
「That red one in the lead...!
　Charging in alone, must be quite confident!」

stage0015_04:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「I'm fine...!
　I won't think about that right now...!」

stage0015_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（The unit's just red, that's all...
　I can't just assume it's them...）

stage0015_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（But, what is this...?
　This intense pressure...）

stage0015_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
???
「That Gundam doesn't seem to be out yet...」

stage0015_04:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
???
「Then let me have a look.
　At how Londo Bell fights...!」

stage0015_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$ミヒロ$$
「The No. 2 catapult hatch is open!」

stage0015_04:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$ミヒロ$$
「This is... Ensign $$リディ$$'s $$リゼル$$
　and that white mobile suit!」

stage0015_04:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$ and $$バナージ$$...!」

stage0015_04:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
???
「So the new Gundam has come out...」

stage0015_04:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$リディ$$
「Can you do this, $$バナージ$$?」

stage0015_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$リディ$$
「The Unicorn's equipped with the weapon
　we recovered at Industrial 7.」

stage0015_04:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$リディ$$
「That pilot suit you're wearing
　is custom-made too, so it should help.」

stage0015_04:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$バナージ$$
「If I said I wasn't, I'd be lying.
　But...」

stage0015_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$バナージ$$
「I have to do this, I do...!」

stage0015_04:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$リディ$$
「Understood.
　Let's team up and go.」

stage0015_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$オットー$$
「Is this alright, $$アルベルト$$?」

stage0015_04:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「T-the Unicorn was built
　based on $$シナンジュ$$ data...!
　It might actually be able to fight...!」

stage0015_04:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$アルベルト$$
（If it's destroyed, that's fine too.
　If the key's destroyed, the box's secret stays safe!）

stage0015_04:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$アデナウアー$$
「Come back, $$リディ$$!
　If you were to lose your life,
　the Marcenas family would...!」

stage0015_04:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$リディ$$
「My family has nothing to do with this!」

stage0015_04:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$リディ$$
「Sorry you had to see that...
　Forget what just happened.」

stage0015_04:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$リディ$$
「Let's go!
　We'll protect the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ ourselves!」

stage0015_04:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
???
「...No time to play around.
　Time I finished this off.」

stage0015_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$リディ$$
「Protecting civilians is a soldier's duty...!」

stage0015_04:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
???
「The key to the box... I'll take it...!」

stage0015_04:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$アムロ$$
「You there, the $$リゼル$$, fall back!
　This is as far as you can go!」

stage0015_04:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Saved! The super ace has arrived!」

stage0015_04:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$エマ$$
「So the $$ラー・カイラム$$'s here too.」

stage0015_04:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$ブライト$$
「This ship will support the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$
　while we strike at Neo Zeon!」

stage0015_04:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$オットー$$
「Thank you, Commander $$ブライト$$!」

stage0015_04:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$アムロ$$
「You there, white mobile suit, can you fight?」

stage0015_04:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I'll cover you.
　Match your movements to mine.」

stage0015_04:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
???
「Heh... so this is what they call fate...」

stage0015_04:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Be careful, Captain $$アムロ$$!
　That's...!」

stage0015_04:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
???
「Then let this hand purge that karma...!」

stage0015_04:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Again...!
　The same thing as back then!」

stage0015_04:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$アムロ$$
「That unit... is that a Gundam?!」

stage0015_04:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
???
「Is this good fortune...?
　Or is it fate after all...」

stage0015_04:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Is it this suit...!
　This lets me withstand the acceleration!」

stage0015_04:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「Can you hear me, $$バナージ・リンクス$$!
　After NT-D activates, the limit is 5 minutes!」

stage0015_04:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$バナージ$$
「NT-D...
　So that's this system's name...」

stage0015_04:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「Any longer, even in the special suit,
　and the pilot's body won't hold up!
　The system cuts out automatically at 5 minutes!」

stage0015_04:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「Bring him down before then... the $$シナンジュ$$!」

stage0015_04:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$アムロ$$
（What is this, this Gundam...
　Is this... a weapon...?）

stage0015_04:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
???
「Come, then, key to the Box, and $$アムロ$$...」

stage0015_04:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
???
「I've achieved the bare minimum...
　That's enough for today.」

stage0015_04:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
???
「A man riding such a pathetic mobile suit
　gives me no reason to fight...」

stage0015_04:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Now that the Colonel has withdrawn,
　there's no reason for us to stay in the field.
　Fall back.」

stage0015_04:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$レイアム$$
「Thanks to the Unicorn and Ensign $$リディ$$'s fight.」

stage0015_04:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$アムロ$$
「...I know what you want to say.
　Let's talk about that red mobile suit later.」

stage0015_04:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Was I... able to protect... $$オードリー$$...?」

stage0015_04:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$アムロ$$
「...Would you tell me your name?」

stage0015_04:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I see.
　You've got something good in you...」

stage0015_04:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Was I... able to protect... $$オードリー$$...?」

stage0015_04:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$アムロ$$
「...Would you tell me your name?」

stage0015_04:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I see.
　You've got something good in you...」

stage0015_04:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Such disgrace, right before the Colonel's eyes...!」

stage0015_04:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
???
「Fall back, Captain.
　Leave the rest to me.」

stage0015_04:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
???
「Protecting my men's lives is a commander's duty too.
　I know you can't accept it, but heed my orders.」

stage0015_04:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
Angelo
「...My apologies.
　$$アンジェロ・ザウパー$$, falling back.」

stage0015_04:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
???
「An opponent strong enough to down $$アンジェロ$$.
　I can't afford to let my guard down, it seems...」

stage0015_04:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$バナージ$$
「I can fight without the NT-D...!
　I'll show you...!」

stage0015_04:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
???
「Good reflexes.
　I'll say you live up to your name.」

stage0015_04:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「My movements are being read...!?」

stage0015_04:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
???
「Of course.
　I know you well, after all.」

stage0015_04:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Acting so suggestive...!
　Are you fighting this as some kind of game!?」

stage0015_04:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$シン$$
「This unit's movements... don't tell me...!?」

stage0015_04:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
???
「Call it a $$ザフト$$ unit if you like, to me it's a Gundam.
　I'll be sending it to the bottom...!」

stage0015_04:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「This unit... belongs to a Neo Zeon officer?」

stage0015_04:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
???
「Knowing that, and still charging in with a $$リーオー$$.
　Such recklessness... is it youth?」

stage0015_04:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
???
「Can you feel me, $$アムロ$$?
　Heh heh...」

stage0015_04:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
???
「Hearing those words from you is enough.
　That's what gives me meaning.」

stage0015_04:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
???
「So this is the key... this new Gundam.」

stage0015_04:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$バナージ$$
「His power... it's overwhelming!
　But even so...!」

stage0015_04:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$リディ$$
「This guy...!
　Playing at being the Red Comet!」

stage0015_04:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
???
「Aptly put.
　But I too know full well what I must do!」

stage0015_04:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$n
「So strong...!
　Is this really human strength...!?」

stage0015_04:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
???
「If you've felt the gap in our skill, then withdraw.
　I don't intend to fight a pointless battle.」

stage0015_04:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$n
「As if this were pointless...!
　Green as I am, amateur as I am,
　I've got my own reason to fight!」

stage0015_04:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「So that's the Gundam that's the key to the Box!」

stage0015_04:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$バナージ$$
「This guy... the squad's captain!?」

stage0015_04:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
Angelo
「I can't disgrace myself before the Colonel!
　Personal Guard Captain $$アンジェロ・ザウパー$$ will
　bring this Gundam down!」

stage0015_04:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Londo Bell's ace, $$アムロ・レイ$$!
　Defeating you will prove the strength of the
　Colonel's Personal Guard!」

stage0015_04:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I've no time for your cheap pride...!
　I won't be a stepping stone for your vanity!」

stage0015_04:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Big talk!
　But while I stand, none shall reach the Colonel!」

stage0015_04:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Damn Neo Zeon...!
　Moving their forces so brazenly...!」

stage0015_04:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$メラン$$
「That red mobile suit... don't tell me...」

stage0015_04:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$ブライト$$
「The Red Comet is our enemy!
　No matter who's piloting it, we'll strike it down!」
